rules: Formal production tasks are created only by R01.
Every executable task belongs to exactly one role_id. Parallel roles receive separate task files even when they share a parent stage.
R02/R03/R04 and R10/R11/R12 therefore never share an idempotency_key.
Parallel roles write separate output paths and never overwrite each other.
If an identical idempotency_key already has a valid COMPLETE delivery and dependencies are unchanged, do not regenerate.
dependency_revision must identify the exact upstream candidate set, lock/input set, or asset manifest dependency consumed by this role.
User substantive requirement change increments input_revision and creates a new task_version; old task becomes SUPERSEDED.
No role may infer missing locks, assets, tasks, or deliveries by scanning directories.
